name: video-editing-skill
title_zh: 剪哪刀、接哪帧、变速多少都写进清单的剪辑执行器
tagline_zh: Agent 想好怎么剪，它负责不差分毫地执行：裁剪、拼接、转场、变速、缩放、叠图，每步操作都带来源映射。
tagline_en: Agent decides, it executes exactly: trim, concat, speed, resize, overlay—each op mapped to source frames.
desc_en: Deterministic video editing from a typed edit request (trim, cut, concat with transitions, speed change, fit / fill / resize, still-image overlay) with an exact source-to-timeline mapping and per-operation provenance. Executes through ffmpeg-skill; never takes commands, argv, filter strings or executables. Use when an agent has already decided what to edit and needs the edit performed, verified an
why_zh: 不碰命令行、不拼滤镜串，只吃结构化编辑请求；每刀都有出处可溯，剪错了能指到具体那一步，而不是黑盒重来。
why_en: No argv, no filter strings—only typed edit intents. Every operation carries provenance, so failures trace to one step, not a.
limit_zh: 只做已定稿的编辑执行，不负责创意决策；依赖 ffmpeg-skill 且本机需有 ffmpeg；不支持音频轨道处理。
limit_en: Executes only decided edits—no creative suggestions. Needs ffmpeg-skill + local ffmpeg. No audio tracks, subtitles, or keyframe animation.
title_en: Edit executor: every trim, cut, speed written as a checklist
